name: CreateCustomAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom attribute. The ID must match the regular expression `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`. The part after \`custom-attribute:\` must be less than 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性ID，需匹配 `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`，custom-attribute: 后面的部分长度小于100
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the custom attribute. The name must be less than 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性展示名称，长度小于128个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the custom attribute. Valid values are ENUM, TEXT, and HYPERLINK
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性类型，支持 ENUM、TEXT、HYPERLINK
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The list of applicable entity types. You can specify precise entity types or use wildcards such as `*-table` and `*-column`. Examples:

dataworks-project: a DataWorks workspace.

dataworks-dataset: a DataWorks dataset.

maxcompute-table: a MaxCompute table.

*-column: all field types
parameters.help_zh:
适用实体类型列表，支持精确实体类型以及 `*-table`、`*-column` 通配写法，如
dataworks-project 工作空间
dataworks-dataset dataworks数据集
maxcompute-table maxcompute表
*-column 所有字段类型
parameters.name: entity_types

parameters.help_en: The enumeration values. This parameter is required when \`Type\` is set to \`ENUM\`. It is not supported for the TEXT and HYPERLINK types
parameters.help_zh: 枚举可选值，type=ENUM时必填；TEXT、HYPERLINK类型不支持
parameters.name: value_enums

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display the attribute on the product page. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否在详情页展示，默认为true
parameters.name: display_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the attribute can be used as a filter on the Data Map search page. The default value is false. Currently, you can set this parameter to true only for attributes of the ENUM type
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持在数据地图搜索页作为筛选条件，默认为false，目前仅ENUM类型配置该值为true
parameters.name: search_filter_enabled

parameters.help_en: The description of the custom attribute. The description must be less than 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义属性描述，长度小于256个字符
parameters.name: comment
